what_changed: Completes production wiring of `dispatch_subagent` across three dimensions: (1) JSON payloads are now wrapped in `<inputs>…</inputs>` framing with pinned execution instructions (`Execute the Job`, `Return ONLY`, `no prose`, `no markdown fences`, `no clarifying questions`) so the LLM executes the job rather than analyzing the raw JSON; (2) `subprocess.run()` receives an explicit `cwd` argument threaded through all nine call sites in `orchestrator_runner.py` and `verify_runner.py` so each agent loads the correct `CLAUDE.md`; (3) `--plugin-dir` (auto-detected via `Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent`) and `--allowedTools Bash Read Write Edit WebFetch` are added to the CLI argv so agent plugins resolve without a user install and can execute their declared tools non-interactively. Ten new unit tests cover all three fixes plus failure-mode preservation; the full suite runs 146 green.
why: The first live Mode B smoke test against ADIS exposed three compounding bugs at the same dispatch boundary, all rooted in `dispatch_subagent` treating the subprocess call as a fire-and-forget shell command rather than a configured agent dispatch. Without prompt framing the LLM emitted markdown clarifying questions instead of JSON; without CWD propagation agents inherited the parent process directory and loaded the wrong `CLAUDE.md` (confirmed by the smoke run referencing `scripts/state_io.py` from the wrong project); without `--plugin-dir` and `--allowedTools` agents failed to resolve unless the plugin was user-installed and could not execute their declared tools.
notes: PR is stacked on CCE-2; must be merged after CCE-2 lands.
